content: David, ai-nuedid
David, Saúlʼbo-sunmaksad-bergusgua, Saúl, David-susad ega-arbaega. A-iba-akale, Saúl, David-e-bab-negse-naega bar imaksasulid.
Jonatánʼdi, Davidʼbo ai-nuedga gunonimalad. Degisoggu, Jonatán, bela-bela David-sabgusad.
Ar Jonatán bela-bela David-sabsoggu, Davidʼbo igar-mesisad.
A-ulale, Jonatán, e-mor-dummad-suid-yoid unnusad, geb Davidʼga uksad. Deginbali, we-ibmarmar ega uksabalid: E-mor-baigan, e-es-suid, e-warsi, degi, e-molidub.

Ibu Saúl, Davidʼga sokardibe, David, bela Saúl-sogedba ibmar-imakdaed. A-ulale, Saúl, David-e-sorda-bila-onomalad-e-iduedga onugsasad. Weyob Saúl, David-onugsasadi, bela Saúl-sordamar, degi, sorda-e-dummaganse-bakale, nued-itosmalad.
Saúl Davidʼgi nobed
David-Goliat-oburgwisad-sorba sordamar-aibiris-danimargua, bela Israel-yargi neggweburmar-bukwadgi omegan Rey-Saúl-abindakega ainiarmalad.
Weligwaledba gar-pandero-abargi gwirnanaid, gar-lira-abargi weyob namaknanaid:
Weyob namaknanaid-ulale, Saúl isdar-itode gandikidba ibmar-sogded: “¡Davidʼnik sogmala, miliambe dulemar-oburgwisye (10,000), andi unnila miligwen oburgwisye (1,000). Unnila reyga mesedpi-napmalad!”
A-iba-akale, Saúl, Davidʼgi nobguded.
A-bangine, David gar-arpa-ogorsigua, Bab-Dummad burba-isganaga Saúl-urmaksad. Degidbali, Saúl e-neggi yogasaar gole-gole gualid, degine, eswar-annik gudii gualid.
Degidgine, Saúl, Davidʼgi ukiagwar eswar-meted, ar binsasad, “¡Galuba-mesa an David-makoye!” Deyobi Davidʼgi eswar-misad. Davidʼdi ilabogus nabir idu aibacha-imaksadaed.
Saúl wisid Bab-Jehová bar eba gudisuli, emidi, Davidʼba gudii. A-ulale, Saúl, David-dobee-itoged.
Agala, mer bar David-e-walik-gudiguega, bila-onolegedgi emar-idugega, sordamar-miliba-mergued-e-dummadga (1,000) nug-imaksad.
David bela ibmar-imakalile, ega nueganbi gusdaed, ar ade, Bab-Jehová eba gudiid.
Saúl, Davidʼga bela ibmar-nueganbi-gue dakargua, dobe-itoded.
Bela Israel-yargindi, degi, Judá-yargindi, David-sabmalad. Ar David, bela bila-onolegedgi sordamar-idudidaed.

Ibagwengine, Saúl, Davidʼga sokalid: —An-sisgwa-dummad Merabʼye-nugad an bega ukoed. Unnila an bega sogo, dule-buled na be imako, Bab-Jehová-nuggi bila-onodii be guo. Ar Saúl binsaed: “An-sunnad mer an David-oburgo. Bur Filistea-sordamar oburgoed.”
David, Saúl-abin sogded: —¿Ande doasunna rey-e-sapinga-guega? ¿An-gwenadgande doamarsunna rey-e-gwenadganga gumalagar?
Degi-inigwele, Saúl, Davidʼga e-sisgwa-Merab-uked-ibagan-mosgua, Saúl, dule-Meholatʼgined-Adrielʼye-nugadga e-sisgwa uksad.
Saúl-e-sisgwa-baid-Micalʼye-nugad David-abealid. Geb Saúlʼga sogsamargua, Saúl yeer-itoalid,
geb binsasad: “An Davidʼga yamo Mical-ukoed, adi, degidba, an David, Filistea-dulemarse-burgwega imakoed.” Degisoggu, Saúl, Davidʼga gannar sogdebalid: —Emi an-sapinga be guoed.
Geb degine, Saúl e-maimarga sogded: —Davidʼbo arbakee be sunmakmala, ega be sogmalo: ‘Rey be-sabed, bela e-maimar be-sabmarmogad. E-sapinga be gue.’
Davidʼga weyob ibmar-sogsamalad, Davidʼdi abin-imaksad: —Ar rey-sapinga-gued, ¿ibmar ibgwensur-guedye be bimala? Unnila andi dule-wilegedid, dule-nug-nikasulidid.
Saúl-e-maimar nadmalad, geb igi David e-abin-imaksa Saúlʼga sogsamalad.

Saúl gannar ega sogdebalid: —Davidʼga be sogmalo: ‘Rey na e-sisgwa-ukoedgi ega ome-nikuedgi-gusgu-ibmar-ukleged-anale, Filistea-dulemar-e-abgan-uka-duku dulatar (100) abeged. Ar unnila, e-isdarmalad-buged-mai imakbied.’ Ar Saúl abeged Filistea-dulemar David-oburgwed.
Saúl-e-maimar, Davidʼga ibmar-sogsamargua, David rey-sapinga-guoed na yeer-itosad. Amba yoo ome-nikued-iba-mogua,

David na e-sordaganmala Filistea-dulemar-oburgwega naded, geb dulataled-ilabo (200) oburgwisad. Degine, David reyga Filistea-dulemar-e-abgan-uka-duku senonikid, adi, e-sapinga guegar. Weyobi, Saúl Davidʼga na e-sisgwa-Mical uksad.
Saúl, Bab-Jehová-Davidʼba-gudiid magar daksad, degi, e-sisgwa-Mical-nue-Davidʼbina-soged magar daksabalid.
A-ulale, Saúl bur bule David-dobguded, geb e-isdaradga degisadegu gunonikid.

Deginbali, Filistea-sordamar-e-dummagan Israel-sordamargi bila-onoged-irbali, David, Saúl-sordamar-e-dummagan-bamaladba bur Filistea-sordamar-e-dummagangi nakwisdaed. Degidbali, David dule-nuga-nikadga gunonikid.
